# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_kobold_forge.py" from kobold_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.
# Additive hooks: they merge with the other files' on-actions.

on_monthly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_started }
		DA_KB_monthly = yes
	}
}

on_yearly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_started }
		DA_KB_yearly = yes
	}
}

on_startup = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_started }
		DA_KB_refresh = yes
		DA_KB_inv_reconcile = yes	# doc 67: the capacity the inventions book
	}
}

# Step 2 (doc 60): the ruler marks of a new ruler; a Molt Ceremony ends with its ruler.
on_new_monarch = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_started }
		DA_KB_new_ruler = yes
	}
}

on_monarch_death = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_ceremony_on }
		DA_KB_ruler_died = yes
	}
}
